preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 2 * 10**5 for x in stdin.split()[:2])
preconditions.description: The first two integers in stdin are n and w, where 1 ≤ n, w ≤ 2·10^5.
The input contains exactly n + w + 2 integers: n, w, followed by n integers for the bears' wall and w integers for the elephant's wall.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in stdin.split()[2:2+n]) and all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in stdin.split()[2+n:2+n+w])
preconditions.description: The heights of the bears' wall towers (ai) and the elephant's wall towers (bi) are integers between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(1 for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, min(n + 1, i + w + 1)) if all(stdin.split()[2 + k] == stdin.split()[2 + n + l] for k in range(i, j) for l in range(j - i))))
postconditions.description: The output is the count of all segments of contiguous towers in the bears' wall (of length exactly w) where the sequence of heights matches the sequence of heights in the elephant's wall, allowing for any vertical shift (i.e., adding a constant to all bi to match ai).
